name: Tamar
summary: A daughter of King David and the sister of Absalom. Her brother Amnon forced her, and Absalom later had him killed for it.

key_moments.title: Forced by Amnon
key_moments.description: David sent Tamar to bake cakes for her brother Amnon, who was pretending to be sick. Alone with her in his room, Amnon would not listen to her pleas and forced her.

key_moments.title: Put Out by Amnon
key_moments.description: Afterward Amnon hated Tamar and had her put out. She put ashes on her head and tore her robe of many colors, and she lived desolate in her brother Absalom's house.
